description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'FieldInfo' that models form field information within the OFBiz widget framework. It includes constants for different field types, supports parsing from XML elements, and defines methods for processing and rendering form fields, as well as managing field type mappings.

classes.name: FieldInfo
classes.description: An abstract class representing form field metadata within the OFBiz widget subsystem. Implements some utility methods for field type handling and defines abstract methods for accepting visitors, copying, and rendering field information.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Abstract method to accept a visitor that performs operations on this FieldInfo instance.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Abstract method to create a copy of this FieldInfo instance associated with a different ModelFormField.

methods.name: getFieldSource
methods.description: Returns the source of the field, e.g., explicit, auto from entity, or auto from service.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Returns the type of the field, such as text, date, checkbox, etc.

methods.name: getModelFormField
methods.description: Returns the ModelFormField associated with this field info.

methods.name: renderFieldString
methods.description: Abstract method to render the field as a string, writing to an Appendable with provided context and renderer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString() to produce an XML representation of the widget field via a visitor.
